title: pave-init run state (run-state.json)
description: Single shape authority for a pave-init run's persisted state, implementing the state contract in references/pave-init.pave.yaml. State points; artifacts prove: fields hold positions, statuses, counters, and artifact paths - never artifact content. Per-entry free-text fields declare maxLength caps (references/pave-spec.md section 8.1); an entry that needs more cites an artifact path instead. `notes` is this file's single deliberately unconstrained escape hatch, counted against a whole-file warn threshold of 131072 bytes - scripts/validate_run_state.py warns past it and names the compaction action, never refusing the write. $defs.planning_queue and $defs.node_draft are the shape authorities for the Stage 3 planning files (planning/planning-queue.yaml and planner drafts); scripts/validate_run_state.py --planning-queue checks instances of them plus the hand rules a shape schema cannot express (see references/planning-layout.md).

fitness_override.description: Compact record of the not_fit override the user approved, shaped per orchestration/interview-and-fitness.md section 5; the full rationale lives in requirements.md#fitness-override (the fitness_override_record artifact). Its free-text keys are capped rather than left loose because pave-spec.md section 8.1 allows one unconstrained escape hatch per file and `notes` holds it. Keys beyond the five declared stay allowed so the recipe can grow.

artifact.description: Path of the persisted exploration/<angle>.md report.

planning_queue_entries.description: Path of planning/planning-queue.yaml, which is the authority for entries and their lifecycle; null before Stage 3. Its shape authority is $defs.planning_queue in this schema; check it with scripts/validate_run_state.py --planning-queue.

build_units.description: Unit list or a pointer to the section of skill-package-plan.md that enumerates them.

validation_results.description: Path of reviews/validation.md; null before Stage 6.

forward_test_result.description: Path of reviews/forward-test.md; null before the forward test.

revision_log_state.description: One line at delivery: the shipped revisions.yaml entry 0 digest and location, or the written reason for leaving it out for a one-session workflow (references/pave-revisions.md). Null before delivery.

note.description: One-line context. Longer content lives in an artifact cited under evidence, never here.

notes.description: Free-form prose home for anything the fields above do not carry. This file's single deliberately unconstrained escape hatch (references/pave-spec.md section 8.1), counted against the whole-file warn threshold declared above.

planning_queue.title: planning/planning-queue.yaml
planning_queue.description: The Stage 3 planning queue. The lead is the only writer. Per-entry free-text fields declare maxLength caps; the planning queue-level `notes` is this file's single unconstrained escape hatch, counted against the same 131072-byte whole-file warn threshold as run-state.json. A shape schema cannot express the write-ownership and lifecycle rules; those live in references/planning-layout.md and the hand rules of validate_run_state.py --planning-queue.

entries.description: One entry per planning queue node, keyed by node id.

conflicts.description: The run's conflict list. Conflict ids are lead-assigned here and nowhere else; a planner node draft that mints one is a validator error.

notes.description: Free-form prose home: run lessons, assembly items, scratch notes. This file's single deliberately unconstrained escape hatch, counted against the whole-file warn threshold.

status.description: pending -> pending_dispatched (planner sent) -> planned (draft on disk) -> reviewed (reviewer PASS); stale when a resynchronization touches an interface the entry depends on.

contract.description: Frozen contract reference: a lead-authored contract file for the root, else <parent-draft-path>#<node-id>.

draft.description: Workspace-relative draft path, minted by the lead at dispatch. One path per dispatch, never reused; a redispatch mints a new path. Required from pending_dispatched onward (validator hand rule).

prediction.description: The framing planner's one-agent check prediction with its one-line rationale; the node's own dispatch confirms or overturns it.

dependencies.description: Sibling entry keys whose frozen interfaces this node consumes. A resynchronization that changes an interface marks every reviewed dependent stale (orchestration/explore-and-plan.md section 4.4).

notes.description: Entry prose: dispatch notes, review summaries, retractions. Capped per entry; content that needs more lives in an artifact cited by path. The planning queue-level notes field is the file's one unconstrained escape hatch, not this.

id.description: Lead-assigned, unique across the run. Planners report conflicts without ids; the lead registers and numbers them here.

raised_by.description: Planning queue entry key that reported it.

node_draft.title: planner drafts (*.draft.pave.yaml for a dispatched node plan)
node_draft.description: A node planner's draft for one dispatched node: authored child node bodies plus planning marks. The dispatched node's own five-part contract is frozen in the parent draft; the node draft references it via extensions.x_planning and never carries slots for it - a node draft that re-authors its dispatched node under nodes is a validator error. The root plan draft is a full graph file, not a node draft; validate_pave.py owns it.

name.description: The dispatched node's id. Must not reappear as a key under nodes (validator hand rule).

nodes.description: Authored child node bodies only. Node shape is references/pave.schema.json's authority, not this schema's.

x_planning.description: Planning marks: dispatched_node, frozen_contract_reference (path + node), elaboration verdicts and predictions, evidence questions, interface findings. Intentionally loose - except that no mapping under it may carry an 'id' key in the lead-owned conflict namespace (c<N>): those ids are lead-assigned in planning-queue.yaml's conflict list; node-local labels (n1, e1, ...) are fine (validator hand rule).
